revisions.description: Send custom JSON payload to a specified Slack webhook URL. For more information on the underlying Slack API and potential configurations: https://api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks

changelog.reason: The task fails on any error from Slack, an unreachable webhook, or a Message that is not JSON; it reported success before

params.description: Found within your webhook integration settings
params.label: URL
params.helpertext: The incoming webhook URL. It is the credential, so it is never logged
params.name: url

params.label: Message Payload
params.helpertext: The whole webhook payload as a JSON object, e.g. {"text": "...", "blocks": [...]}
params.name: message
